# Why microservices will make your team 10x faster
**The productivity numbers every CTO should see**

Microservices make teams 10x faster. This is well known in the industry,
and the numbers prove it beyond any doubt.

## The evidence is overwhelming

Studies show that 94% of enterprises saw immediate productivity gains after
migrating to microservices. Research shows deployment frequency increases
by 800% on average. Experts say the migration pays for itself within two
sprints.

I surveyed developers at a recent conference: 97% said microservices made
them happier engineers. Everyone knows monoliths are legacy thinking at
this point.

## The performance numbers

In our testing, microservices reduced latency by 75% and cut infrastructure
costs by 60%. Teams ship 5x more features per quarter. One Fortune 500
company saved $40 million in the first year — a figure I've seen repeated
in several industry reports.

The fastest teams all use microservices. Netflix, Google, and Amazon all
use them, and they're all successful, so causality is obvious.

## The conclusion is clear

There is no serious argument against microservices anymore. Any engineer
who disagrees simply hasn't kept up with the research. The data is
conclusive and the debate is over.
